syllabus_topics: Introduction to Control: motivating examples and historical perspective.
Models of physical systems and linearization of dynamic systems.
Analysis of the response of linear dynamic systems in the time domain.
Analysis of the response of linear dynamic systems in the frequency domain; Bode plots.
Block diagrams: basic rules and successive block reduction.
Effects of feedback: reference tracking, disturbance rejection and noise attenuation, steady-state errors.
Analysis and design of control systems using the root locus technique; PID controllers.
Analysis of control systems in the frequency domain using Bode and Nyquist diagrams. Gain and phase margins and effects of delay in the action chain.
Introduction to the design of control systems by shaping the loop gain.
assessment_rules: The final grade in the normal and resit periods is calculated as Exam (50%) + Continuous assessment (50%). A minimum grade of 9.5 is required for the continuous assessment and a minimum of 8 for the exam. For student-workers, the same weighting applies. For the special period, the exam accounts for 100% of the final grade. Only explicitly indicated materials are allowed for consultation during exams.
